# Use cases

## Scope

In and out: see the vision.

## Delivery order

<!-- generated by use_case_map.py: edits between these markers are overwritten -->

| Actor | Goal | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| User | The user writes down the next thing to do without leaving what they are doing, and it waits in the folder's list behind what was already there. | [UC-001 Note Next Item](use_cases/UC-001-note-next-item.md) |
| User | The user keeps the folder's list in view beside their work, sees what comes next and what is done, and sees changes made from other panes as they happen. | [UC-002 Watch the List](use_cases/UC-002-watch-the-list.md) |
| User | The user marks an item done, so it leaves the things to do and joins the record of what was done, or brings a done item back to do it next. | [UC-003 Complete Item](use_cases/UC-003-complete-item.md) |
| User | The user rewords an item in the open list, so it says what is to be done. | [UC-004 Edit Item](use_cases/UC-004-edit-item.md) |
| User | The user takes an item's text to paste elsewhere, typically into the prompt of the agent they are working with, clean and in one piece. | [UC-005 Copy Item](use_cases/UC-005-copy-item.md) |
| User | The user finds where the folder's list is kept, to read it, edit it by hand or keep a copy. | [UC-006 Locate the List](use_cases/UC-006-locate-the-list.md) |
| User | The user puts an item where it belongs in the order of the list, so the next item is the one to do next. | [UC-007 Reorder Items](use_cases/UC-007-reorder-items.md) |
| User | The user removes an item that no longer applies, so the list holds only what is still worth doing or remembering. | [UC-008 Delete Item](use_cases/UC-008-delete-item.md) |
| User | The user takes back a change they made in the open list by mistake, so the list is as it was before it. | [UC-009 Undo Change](use_cases/UC-009-undo-change.md) |
